teams.synopsis: The most points for in the league by a wide margin despite a 5-3 record - could this finally be Maney's year?
teams.blurb: Despite being 5-3, Shakir has the most points for by a large margin and has been extremely hot. Watch out for this team as he makes a playoff run. Could it finally be Maney's year?

teams.synopsis: The most wins in the league, coming off the first loss of the season - still a juggernaut and a top-2 team.
teams.blurb: Despite having the most wins, MFGA is coming off their first loss of the season. They should be by no means worried, as <mark class="hl-player">Lamar</mark> is still out and <mark class="hl-player">Bijan</mark> went poopular. MFGA is still a juggernaut and should be considered a top-2 team.

teams.synopsis: Squeaked out a Week 8 win over the Minutemen - now with the second-best record in the league, playoffs are all but locked.
teams.blurb: After squeaking out a win in week 8 against the Minutemen, Monke now has the second-best record in the league. With playoffs all but locked, Monke looks to finish strong and make another attempt to bring home the trophy.

teams.synopsis: A dominating Week 8 win shows Potty is not to be messed with - Jonathan Taylor has been nearly perfect.
teams.blurb: A dominating win in week 8 has shown that Potty is not to be messed with. <mark class="hl-player">Jonathan Taylor</mark> has been short of perfect, and if his team can keep it up, expect a playoff run.

teams.synopsis: The flowers are fully here after another good week - a strong 4-game win streak with James Cook fully back.
teams.blurb: After another good week, the flowers are fully here, top 5. <mark class="hl-player">James Cook</mark> looks like he's fully back, and this team is on a strong 4-game win streak. Expect playoffs for Routens with an easy rest-of-season schedule.

teams.synopsis: Feels weird ranking a 3-5 team this high, but the roster is loaded - the easiest schedule in the league sets up a bounce-back.
teams.blurb: While it feels weird putting a 3-5 team so high, the roster is full of talent; it just suffered some brutal duds by <mark class="hl-player">QJ</mark> and <mark class="hl-player">Ferguson</mark> last week. While they need to win now, they do have the easiest schedule in the league - expect a bounce-back week in week 9.

teams.synopsis: On a 3-game winning streak despite the 5th nickname change of the season - handing The King his first loss would be a great next step.
teams.blurb: On a 3-game winning streak, TATY has shown he hasn't given up this year (even after his 5th name change). With a hard rest-of-season schedule, he'll need to keep winning, but handing The King his first loss is a good step. Playoffs are in reach; TATY just needs to keep his same pace.

teams.synopsis: A tough Week 8 loss didn't help matters against the hardest remaining schedule in the league - a healthy Puka could still save the season.
teams.blurb: A tough loss in week 8 did not help Grits, who still has the hardest rest-of-season schedule. Especially with the loss of <mark class="hl-player">Skat</mark> (RIP), but <mark class="hl-player">Puka</mark> coming back can save this team. Grits has only slipped; he'll need to get back up and quick to keep his playoff spot.

teams.synopsis: Ranked in the same spot as last week - a much-needed Week 8 win keeps the playoff hopes alive.
teams.blurb: Ranked in the same spot as last week, Butter's situation hasn't changed much. A much-needed win in week 8 keeps their playoff hopes alive, and with an above-average rest-of-season schedule, Butter is gonna need some more <mark class="hl-player">Breece Hall</mark> passing touchdowns to make it to the playoffs.

teams.synopsis: A rough Week 8 loss hurts the playoff chances, but it's not over yet - Bucky returning is the key to a late push.
teams.blurb: GERM. A rough loss in week 8 hurts Warren(t)'s playoff chances, but it's not over yet. But for a late playoff push to happen, <mark class="hl-player">Bucky</mark> needs to come back. Don't count him out yet, but the chances are running out.

teams.synopsis: Playoffs may be all but out of reach, but a big win over TTF keeps this team well clear of the punishment.
teams.blurb: While playoffs may be all but out of reach, a big win against TTF has kept The King's reserves in a good spot to avoid the punishment. If <mark class="hl-player">Saquon</mark> and <mark class="hl-player">Rice</mark> can keep this up, they should have no worries about coming in last.

teams.synopsis: A 5-game winning streak has this team at 12th despite one fewer win than the team above - a depleted RB room clouds the rest of the season.
teams.blurb: While the team above Cooking has one less win, a 5-game losing streak sits him down at 12th. With a depleted RB room, the rest of the season looks dim, especially after a close loss to Rolls. The punishment should be a long shot, but the playoffs look even further unless the team can hit its stride late.

teams.synopsis: Not much has changed for these bottom-two teams - a win over TTF is a big advantage since wins are hard to come by for both.
teams.blurb: There's not much change with these bottom two teams as compared to last week's, still the same situation. Punishment is still in the cards, but having a win over TTF is a big advantage, as they'll be hard to come by for both teams.

teams.synopsis: No surprise - the only team still with one win stays at 14th, with playoffs now virtually impossible.
teams.blurb: No surprise here, as the only team still with one win, TTF is still ranked 14th. Playoffs are virtually impossible; at this point it's just not going to McDonald's. Not much else to be said.
